allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

rules.description: Array of system invariant rules that must always hold true, expressed as formal or textual constraints.

items.description: A single invariant rule with its formal expression, scope, severity, and traceability.

inv_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this invariant (e.g., 'inv-balance-non-negative').

description.description: Human-readable description of what this invariant enforces.

language.description: Expression language used: jsonlogic (machine-evaluable), cel (Common Expression Language), or text (human-readable).

expression.description: The formal or textual expression of this invariant in the specified language.

scope.description: The components and APIs to which this invariant applies.

components.description: List of component IDs this invariant applies to.

apis.description: List of API IDs this invariant applies to.

severity.description: Violation severity: 'warn' for advisory violations, 'error' for blocking violations.

trace.description: Traceability links back to upstream requirements, APIs, or components.

items.description: A traceability reference for this invariant rule.

policy_ref.description: Canonical reference to the governance policy this invariant enforces.

risk_category_ref.description: Canonical reference to the risk category this invariant mitigates.

status_ref.description: Canonical reference to the lifecycle status of this invariant.
